params.name: finger_cup_diameter
params.comment: Derived sphere footprint spans the full pad diagonal with 0.5 mm radial margin, avoiding corner-tangent Boolean geometry. The pad clips the spherical surface; no independent circular cup boundary. Face length is the existing fixed 12 mm.

params.name: finger_cup_depth
params.comment: Allowed range 0.5..0.8 mm; default 0.6 mm center depression. Spherical dish spans the complete rectangular top. Physical comfort and print finish pending.
